title: Multi-Character Positioning is not working
body:
### Checklist

- [x] I have searched the existing issues and this is not a duplicate
- [x] I have read the documentation

### Bug Description

Although character positions are passed to the prompt, the `use_coords` param is never set to true, so coordinates are ignored when generating the image.

### Steps to Reproduce

1. Pass 2 characters with different positions into `GenerateImageParams`
2. Call image.generate
3. Create new `GenerateImageParams` with the character positions swapped
4. Run the code again
5. Compare the images

### Expected Behavior

Character positions should be swapped in the generated image

### Actual Behavior

Character positions are not swapped in the generated image

### Minimal Reproducible Example

```python
from novelai import NovelAI
from novelai.types import GenerateImageParams, Character

client = NovelAI(api_key="key")

characters = [
    Character(
        prompt="1girl, red hair, blue eyes",
        enabled=True,
        position=(0.2, 0.5),
    ),
    Character(
        prompt="1boy, black hair, green eyes",
        enabled=True,
        position=(0.8, 0.5),
    ),
]

params = GenerateImageParams(
    prompt="two people standing",
    model="nai-diffusion-4-5-full",
    characters=characters,
    seed=1234
)

images = client.image.generate(params)

with open("img_0.png", "wb") as img:
    images[0].save(img, "PNG")

#swap characters
characters[0].position, characters[1].position = characters[1].position, characters[0].position

images = client.image.generate(params)

with open("img_1.png", "wb") as img:
    images[0].save(img, "PNG")
```
